description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogFilterSpecification class, testing its matching logic against a collection of CatalogItem objects based on filter criteria such as brand and type IDs.

classes.name: CatalogFilterSpecification
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of CatalogFilterSpecification in filtering catalog items based on given criteria.

methods.name: MatchesExpectedNumberOfItems
methods.description: Unit test method that verifies the number of catalog items matched by the specification for various input filter parameters.

methods.name: GetTestItemCollection
methods.description: Helper method that returns a predefined list of CatalogItem objects used in the tests.
